nonGoals: Windows 10 GA support is not part of the 1.x release line.
Enterprise policy control and silent deployment governance are post-MVP scope.
Full guaranteed insertion in elevated/admin targets without signed UIAccess setup is out of scope.
knownLimitations: Fn-key detection depends on OEM firmware and may not be visible to Windows hotkey registration.
Secure fields and protected input surfaces can block insertion by design.
Clipboard-based insertion may be denied by target application policy or timing contention.
mitigations: Provide Hotkey Test page and require user-visible key-event validation.
Expose secure-field detection toggle, blacklist controls, and clear block messaging.
Fallback to SendInput Unicode typing when paste insertion fails.
